about: The words themselves: the full participant-facing consent document in plain English. This is what gets translated, read aloud and printed. Placeholders in {braces} are filled from the project.

sections.title: Why we are doing this study
sections.text: We want to learn about {study_title}. What we learn may help {institution} and people in {site}.

sections.title: What you will do
sections.text: You will answer some questions in one interview with {researcher_name}. You can answer by speaking or by typing. You do not have to answer every question.

sections.title: How long it takes
sections.text: The interview takes {duration}. You can take a break at any time.

sections.title: Risks and discomforts
sections.text: There is no danger to your body. You may feel tired, or a question may feel private. You can skip any question. You can rest or stop at any time. Stopping will not cause you any problem.

sections.title: How this may help
sections.text: Taking part may not help you directly. What we learn may help improve services for people in {site}.

sections.title: Payment
sections.text: You will not be paid for taking part. Taking part does not cost you money.

sections.title: Who will see your answers
sections.text: Only the research team will see your answers. Your name is never written next to your answers. Your answers are locked on this phone and sent safely to {institution}. We keep them for {retention_years} years, then delete them.

sections.title: Your choice
sections.text: Taking part is your choice. You can say no now. You can stop later, even after you have agreed. You do not have to give a reason. Saying no will not change how you are treated, and nothing bad will happen.

sections.title: Who to ask
sections.text: You can ask {researcher_name} any question now or later. Supervisor: {supervisor}.

sections.title: If you want to complain
sections.text: If you are unhappy about this study, you can contact the {institution} ethics office on {ethics_phone}. Ethics approval number: {ethics_ref}.

choices.about: Each needs its own Yes or No. Yes and No carry equal weight: same size, same colour weight, no default.

items.text: I agree to take part in this study
items.note: If this is No, the session ends without a signature and nothing else is asked.

items.text: You may quote my words, without my name
You may contact me again later

signature_block.prompt: How would you like to agree?
signature_block.witness_text: A witness watched this person agree: {witness_name}, {witness_role}.
signature_block.copy_text: You will get a copy of this form to keep.

withdrawal.title: Stopping later
withdrawal.text: If you change your mind, tell {researcher_name} or the ethics office on {ethics_phone}. Your answers will be taken out of the study. Anything already published cannot be taken back.

minors.about: Figma row 10. Guardian consent AND the young person's assent are both needed. A child's No always stops participation.

guardian.title: Permission for your child
guardian.intro: Your child has been asked to take part in {study_title}. You decide first, then we ask your child. If your child says no, we stop, even if you said yes.

choices.text: Photographs of my child may be used

guardian.authority_statement: The researcher confirms this person has legal authority for the child. This is a human decision and it is logged.

assent_12_17.title: It is your choice
assent_12_17.text: Your guardian said it is OK. But you decide too. If you say no, that is fine. Nobody will be upset and nothing bad will happen.
points: We will not tell anyone your name.
assent_12_17.question: Do you want to take part?
assent_12_17.not_sure_note: Not sure pauses so the young person can ask questions. It is not a yes.

assent_7_11.title: Do you want to help with our questions?
assent_7_11.text: We want to ask you some questions. You can say yes or no. If you say no, that is fine.
assent_7_11.note: Pictures and audio only. One question, three big faces.

child_said_no.title: Thank you for telling us
child_said_no.text: That is completely OK. You will not take part, and nothing bad will happen.
child_said_no.researcher_note: Participation stopped. Guardian consent is overridden by the child's No. No answers or recordings are kept; only 'declined (assent)' is logged. The feedback pop-up is never shown to minors.

minors.reconsent_at_18: If the study is still running when the young person turns 18, the app reminds the researcher to ask them for their own consent.

translation_rules: Translate meaning, not words. A literal translation of 'voluntary' is usually wrong.
Keep sentences short. One idea per sentence.
Yes and No must stay short enough to fit a button and must not differ in force.
'You can stop at any time' and 'nothing bad will happen' are legally required reassurances - never drop them for brevity.
If a concept has no word in the language, describe it in a sentence and tell the researcher, rather than borrowing an English word the participant will not know.
